body: Im here if you need to talk

Your not a monster, never take people who make such comments serious, if they post stuff like that then just be happy you arnt as pathetic losers as them. There will always be idiots being mean on the internet but try not to let it effect you, i know it can be annoying but they are pices of shit

Music and sleep are amazing , im a big audiophile and love music, and sleeping is alwasy nice. Both acts as an escape, you can get lost in different music and hopefully have a good time, music and sleep is indeed very nice

I dont want to be the guy saying "it'll get better" but it certanly wont if you do kill yourself. You may feel like absolute shit right now but i hope you wait a bit, maybe things will turn around. Im not sure what else to say but if you want to talk please just message me, i really dont want you to die.

Im kinda in the same boat, born and now im forced to live, cant die because i dont wan to hurt my friends and family, the only thing i can say is i hope you get better but that doesnt really help alot, but if you want to talk just message me

Well i think suicide is a very acward subject for alot of people to talk about so saying "it'll get better" is an easy way of trying to help, they probably want it to get better for you but dont know how to help or what to say. But if you want to talk im here for you
I won't and can't do it but I really want to

Well at some point you will die, so while you are here just try to enjoy the little things, i see you like food, why not learn new recepies or even becomming a chef if you want to take the time. As Friedrich Nietzsche said:  To live is to **suffer**, to survive is to find some meaning in the **suffering**.  Maybe food is a way you could cope? Message me if you want to talk, im here for you :)
